scanNote:
Photo File Section, UNIT 12 varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q.

⚠⚠ BU VARAQ BOShQALARDAN FARQ QILADI: qaychi belgisi (✂) va uzuq chiziq betning O'RTASIDA — jadvaldan PASTDA. Ya'ni faqat PASTKI QISM (maqola qolipi) qirqib olinadi, YUQORIDAGI JADVAL kitobda qoladi. Sababi aniq: jadval — MA'LUMOT MANBAI, maqola yozayotganda kitobda ochiq turishi kerak.

YUQORIDA — 5 qatorli ma'lumot jadvali (ACCOMMODATION, PLACES TO VISIT, EATING OUT, SHOPPING, NIGHTLIFE).

PASTDA — maqola qolipi:
  Sarlavha: 'ANTWERP'
  Kirish (BOSILGAN, qiyshiq harflar): 'This beautiful city in northern Belgium has diamonds, beautiful buildings and lots more.'
  Beshta sarlavha ostida BO'Sh qatorlar: ACCOMMODATION, PLACES TO VISIT, EATING OUT, SHOPPING, NIGHTLIFE.
  Xulosa (BOSILGAN, o'ng pastda): 'Antwerp has so much to offer - it's beautiful, it's interesting and there is always something to do there. For a great holiday in a northern European city, try Antwerp.'

Ikkita rangli surat: chapda sobor minorasi va maydondagi haykal; o'ngda Brabo favvorasi va Grote Markt maydonidagi qadimiy binolar.

⚠ HALOL IZOH 1: jadvalda 'paintings by Paul Rubens' yozilgan. Rassomning to'liq ismi — PETER Paul Rubens (1577-1640). Kitob 'Peter' qismini tushirib qoldirgan.

⚠ HALOL IZOH 2: 'Sir Anthony Van Dijck' — bu rassom Anthony van Dyck (1599-1641) ning FLAMAND tilidagi yozilishi. Ingliz tilida odatda 'Van Dyck' yoziladi. Restoran nomi bo'lgani uchun flamandcha shakl to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin — xato deb hisoblamadim.

⚠ HALOL IZOH 3: 'De Singel' — Antverpendagi san'at markazi (konsert va teatr zallari). Kitob uni opera bilan bog'lagan; shahardagi opera teatri odatda 'Vlaamse Opera' deb ataladi. Bu — dolzarblik masalasi, grammatik xato emas.

⚠ Unitlar tartibi: 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 5, 6, 8, 8, 11, 12.

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 12: Antwerp (write a travel article)

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 12 - Use the information in the table to complete the article about Antwerp.
exercises.instructionUz: 12-UNIT — Jadvaldagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Antverpen haqidagi maqolani to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — MA'LUMOTDAN MAQOLA TUZISh.

  YUQORIDA — tayyor JADVAL (qisqa
     qaydlar).
  PASTDA — maqola QOLIPI (bo'sh
     qatorlar).

  Vazifa: jadvaldagi qisqa qaydlarni
  TO'LIQ GAPlarga aylantirish.


⚠⚠ QAYChI BELGISIGA E'TIBOR BERING:

  Boshqa varaqlarda qaychi betning
  YUQORISIDA edi — butun varaq qirqib
  olinardi.

  Bu betda qaychi O'RTADA — jadvaldan
  PASTDA.

  ⚠ Demak faqat MAQOLA qismi qirqiladi,
  JADVAL kitobda qoladi.

  Sababi: jadval — ma'lumot manbai,
  yozayotganda ko'z oldingizda turishi
  kerak.


KITOB BERGAN JADVAL:

  ACCOMMODATION (turar joy):
     Rosier - expensive, but very
        luxurious hotel
     Hilton - biggest hotel in the city
        centre

  PLACES TO VISIT (ko'riladigan joylar):
     the Brabo Fountain - take photographs
     the Cathedral - see paintings by
        Paul Rubens
     The National Maritime Museum - learn
        about the history of Antwerp
     Antwerp Zoo - one of the biggest in
        Europe

  EATING OUT (tashqarida ovqatlanish):
     Maritime - excellent seafood
        restaurant
     Sir Anthony Van Dijck - restaurant
        with delicious traditional
        French-Belgian cuisine

  SHOPPING (xarid):
     Meir - main shopping street with lots
        of boutiques and Belgian chocolate
        shops
     the diamond quarter - buy or look at
        the beautiful diamonds

  NIGHTLIFE (tungi hayot):
     bars and cafes - listen to live jazz
        music
     De Singel - see an opera


KITOBDA BOSILGAN QISMLAR:

  KIRISh (qiyshiq harflar bilan):
     'This beautiful city in northern
      Belgium has diamonds, beautiful
      buildings and lots more.'

  XULOSA (o'ng pastda):
     'Antwerp has so much to offer - it's
      beautiful, it's interesting and
      there is always something to do
      there. For a great holiday in a
      northern European city, try
      Antwerp.'


TO'LDIRILGAN NAMUNA:

──────────────────────────────────
  ANTWERP

  This beautiful city in northern
  Belgium has diamonds, beautiful
  buildings and lots more.

  ACCOMMODATION
  You can stay at the Rosier. It is
  expensive, but it is a very
  luxurious hotel. The Hilton is the
  biggest hotel in the city centre.

  PLACES TO VISIT
  You can take photographs of the
  Brabo Fountain. Go to the
  Cathedral and see the paintings by
  Paul Rubens. At the National
  Maritime Museum you can learn about
  the history of Antwerp. Don't miss
  Antwerp Zoo - it is one of the
  biggest in Europe.

  EATING OUT
  The Maritime is an excellent
  seafood restaurant. At the Sir
  Anthony Van Dijck you can try
  delicious traditional French-Belgian
  cuisine.

  SHOPPING
  Meir is the main shopping street.
  There are lots of boutiques and
  Belgian chocolate shops. In the
  diamond quarter you can buy or look
  at the beautiful diamonds.

  NIGHTLIFE
  Listen to live jazz music in the
  bars and cafes. You can also see an
  opera at De Singel.

  Antwerp has so much to offer - it's
  beautiful, it's interesting and
  there is always something to do
  there. For a great holiday in a
  northern European city, try
  Antwerp.
──────────────────────────────────


⚠ QAYDDAN GAPGA — UCh XIL YO'L:

  Qayd:
     'Antwerp Zoo - one of the biggest
      in Europe'

  1) 'IT IS' bilan:
     'Antwerp Zoo IS one of the biggest
      in Europe.'

  2) 'YOU CAN' bilan:
     'YOU CAN visit Antwerp Zoo.'

  3) BUYRUQ GAPI bilan:
     'DON'T MISS Antwerp Zoo!'

  ⚠ Sayohat maqolasida uchalasi ham
  aralashtirib ishlatiladi — matn
  jonli chiqadi.


⚠ SAYOHAT MAQOLASI TILI:

  ⚠ 'YOU' — o'quvchiga murojaat:
     'You can stay at...'
     'You can try...'

  ⚠ BUYRUQ GAPI — taklif:
     'Go to the Cathedral.'
     'Don't miss the Zoo!'
     'Try Antwerp.'

  ⚠ KUChLI SIFATLAR:
     luxurious  = hashamatli
     excellent  = a'lo
     delicious  = mazali
     beautiful  = go'zal


⚠ ORTTIRMA DARAJA (jadvalda ikki marta):

     'the BIGGEST hotel'
     'one of the BIGGEST in Europe'

  ⚠ 'ONE OF THE + ORTTIRMA + KO'PLIK':
     'one of the biggest zooS'
     'one of the best restaurantS'

  ⚠ Ma'nosi: 'eng kattalaridan BIRI'
  (eng kattasi emas!)


⚠ 'ACCOMMODATION' — YOZILIShI QIYIN:

     a-c-c-o-m-m-o-d-a-t-i-o-n

  ⚠ IKKI 'c' va IKKI 'm'!

  ⚠ Sanalmaydigan ot:
     'accommodations' ✗ (BrE)


⚠ 'CUISINE' — FRANSUZChA SO'Z:

  'cuisine' [kwi-ZIN] = milliy taomlar
     'French-Belgian cuisine'
     = fransuz-belgiya taomlari

  ⚠ 'kitchen' (oshxona) EMAS!


ANTVERPEN HAQIDA:

  • Belgiyaning shimolida, Flandriya
    o'lkasida.
  • Dunyodagi ENG YIRIK OLMOS savdo
    markazi.
  • Rassom Rubens shu shaharda ishlagan.
  • Yirik dengiz porti (shuning uchun
    'Maritime Museum' bor).

  ⚠ HALOL IZOH: kitobda 'Paul Rubens'
  yozilgan. Rassomning to'liq ismi —
  PETER Paul Rubens (1577-1640).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  accommodation = turar joy
  luxurious    = hashamatli
  a fountain   = favvora
  a cathedral  = sobor
  maritime     = dengizga oid
  a museum     = muzey
  a zoo        = hayvonot bog'i
  seafood      = dengiz mahsulotlari
  cuisine      = milliy taomlar
  a boutique   = butik, kichik do'kon
  a diamond    = olmos, brilliant
  a quarter    = mahalla; chorak
  nightlife    = tungi hayot
  live music   = jonli musiqa
  to offer     = taklif qilmoq
  excellent    = a'lo

points.en: ACCOMMODATION:  Rosier - expensive, but very luxurious hotel / Hilton - biggest hotel in the city centre   →   You can stay at the Rosier. It is expensive, but it is a very luxurious hotel. The Hilton is the biggest hotel in the city centre.
points.uz: Siz Rosier mehmonxonasida qolishingiz mumkin. U qimmat, lekin juda hashamatli. Hilton — shahar markazidagi eng katta mehmonxona.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'ACCOMMODATION' — IKKI 'c' va IKKI 'm'!

⚠ Sanalmaydi: 'accommodations' ✗ (BrE).

⚠ 'the biggEST' — orttirma daraja,
'the' bilan.

'luxurious' = hashamatli.

points.en: PLACES TO VISIT:  the Cathedral - see paintings by Paul Rubens   →   Go to the Cathedral and see the paintings by Paul Rubens.
points.uz: Soborga boring va Paul Rubensning suratlarini ko'ring.
points.noteUz:
⚠ BUYRUQ GAPI — sayohat maqolasida ko'p
ishlatiladi: 'Go to...', 'See...',
'Don't miss...'.

⚠ 'paintings BY Rubens' — muallif oldidan
'BY' ('of' EMAS).

⚠ HALOL IZOH: rassomning to'liq ismi —
PETER Paul Rubens (1577-1640). Kitob
'Peter' ni tushirib qoldirgan.

points.en: PLACES TO VISIT:  Antwerp Zoo - one of the biggest in Europe   →   Don't miss Antwerp Zoo - it is one of the biggest in Europe.
points.uz: Antverpen hayvonot bog'ini o'tkazib yubormang — u Yevropadagi eng kattalaridan biri.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'ONE OF THE + ORTTIRMA + KO'PLIK':
  'one of the biggest zooS'  ✓
  'one of the biggest zoo'   ✗

⚠ Ma'nosi: 'eng kattalaridan BIRI' —
eng kattasi EMAS!

points.en: EATING OUT:  Sir Anthony Van Dijck - restaurant with delicious traditional French-Belgian cuisine   →   At the Sir Anthony Van Dijck you can try delicious traditional French-Belgian cuisine.
points.uz: Sir Anthony Van Dijck restoranida mazali an'anaviy fransuz-belgiya taomlarini tatib ko'rishingiz mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'cuisine' [kwi-ZIN] = MILLIY TAOMLAR.
⚠ 'kitchen' (oshxona) EMAS!

⚠ HALOL IZOH: 'Van Dijck' — rassom Anthony
van Dyck (1599-1641) ismining FLAMANDCHA
yozilishi. Restoran nomi bo'lgani uchun
bu shakl to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin.

points.en: SHOPPING:  the diamond quarter - buy or look at the beautiful diamonds   →   In the diamond quarter you can buy or look at the beautiful diamonds.
points.uz: Olmos mahallasida chiroyli brilliantlarni sotib olishingiz yoki tomosha qilishingiz mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a quarter' IKKI MA'NO:
  1) MAHALLA (shahar qismi) - bu yerda
  2) ChORAK ('a quarter past five')

⚠ Antverpen — dunyodagi eng yirik OLMOS
savdo markazi. Shuning uchun kirishda ham
'has diamonds' yozilgan.

points.en: NIGHTLIFE:  bars and cafes - listen to live jazz music / De Singel - see an opera   →   Listen to live jazz music in the bars and cafes. You can also see an opera at De Singel.
points.uz: Bar va kafelarda jonli jaz musiqasini tinglang. De Singelda operani ham ko'rishingiz mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'LIVE music' [layv] = JONLI musiqa
(yozib olingan emas).
⚠ 'to live' [liv] (yashamoq) bilan bir xil
yoziladi, LEKIN boshqacha o'qiladi!

⚠ HALOL IZOH: 'De Singel' — Antverpendagi
san'at markazi. Shahardagi opera teatri
odatda 'Vlaamse Opera' deb ataladi.

points.en: Antwerp has so much to offer - it's beautiful, it's interesting and there is always something to do there.
points.uz: Antverpen juda ko'p narsa taklif qiladi — u go'zal, qiziqarli va u yerda doim qiladigan ish topiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ KITOBDA BOSILGAN — yozish shart emas.

'to have so much to offer' = juda ko'p
narsa taklif qilmoq.

⚠ 'something to DO' — otdan keyin 'to' +
fe'l.

⚠ 'it's' (= it is) — apostrof BOR.
